hunt.justification: Adversaries using automation and AI to manage thousands of stolen sessions represents a significant escalation in capability. Identifying these hubs neutralizes large-scale phishing backends.

meta.name: Adversary Operational Workflow and AI Automation

related.reason: This hunt focuses on the adversary operating machine, not the phishing landing pages themselves.

meta.analysis: A single alert on Make.com or AI tools is prone to noise. This hunt identifies the cluster of research, automation, and session management characterizing an adversary operating machine.

scenario.summary: A threat actor accidentally installed a security agent on their own operating host, revealing a workflow that utilizes AI tools like Make.com and Toolbaz to automate phishing and message crafting. The adversary searched for Evilginx instances via Censys and maintained access to thousands of compromised identities through session token refreshes from infrastructure hosted on the VIRTUO AS.

meta.rationale: Focus first on systems with multiple security products (Malwarebytes, Bitdefender) as adversaries often use them for testing evasion. The identity sign-in query is fleet-wide to identify the source IP.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is operating a jump box characterized by the installation of multiple security products for research, the use of AI for phishing content generation, and high-volume session maintenance across many compromised identities.

hunt.name: Adversary Operational Workflow and AI Automation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the operating patterns of a professional threat actor who integrates workflow automation and AI into their phishing operations. It follows the adversary's lifecycle from initial software evaluation and research to the backend management of thousands of stolen user sessions. By clustering competitor security software installation with AI writing assistant usage and high-volume authentication attempts from a single source, the hunt pinpoints the attacker's primary infrastructure.

config.rationale: An adversary is operating a jump box characterized by the installation of multiple security products for research, the use of AI for phishing content generation, and high-volume session maintenance across many compromised identities.

nodes.label: Identify hosts with overlapping security tools

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT package_name) as tool_count FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%malwarebytes%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%bitdefender%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%huntress%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING tool_count > 1
config.description: Find systems where multiple security agents are installed, indicating an adversary evaluating competitor defenses.
config.expected_signal: Hosts with more than one security product installed; standard assets usually run exactly one.

primitive_config.label: Identify hosts with overlapping security tools
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT package_name) as tool_count FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%malwarebytes%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%bitdefender%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%huntress%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING tool_count > 1
primitive_config.expected: Hosts with more than one security product installed; standard assets usually run exactly one.

nodes.label: DNS queries for AI writing and research

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookup_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_research_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Identify hosts resolving domains for AI-driven text generation and vulnerability research.
config.expected_signal: Rare resolutions for AI writing assistants or Censys. This establishes the phishing research phase.

config.objective: Identify hosts displaying clustered activity of security software evaluation, AI research, and automation. Distinguish between an external attacker VPS (public IP, no agent presence) and a compromised internal host (private IP, agent present in software inventory).

config.expected_signal: A list of hosts meeting the adversary jump box research profile.
config.success_criteria: A verdict for each host specifying if the pattern matches an adversary operating host.

nodes.label: High-volume identity access from single IP

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_identities, COUNT(*) AS auth_events, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING unique_identities > 5 ORDER BY unique_identities DESC
config.description: Identify source IPs maintaining access to many unique identities.
config.expected_signal: A single IP address managing sessions for a disproportionate number of users.

primitive_config.label: High-volume identity access from single IP
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_identities, COUNT(*) AS auth_events, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING unique_identities > 5 ORDER BY unique_identities DESC
primitive_config.expected: A single IP address managing sessions for a disproportionate number of users.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.expected_signal: Rows mapping suspicious IPs to specific internal devices.

primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
